column1: Jeremy Pena leads the slate with a strong track record of consistency, hitting safely in nearly 74% of games and enjoying a favorable park boost in Oakland. Yandy Diaz also profiles as a reliable option, offering steady production and a slight edge with the platoon advantage. Pete Crow-Armstrong and Ceddanne Rafaela bring upside in plus matchups, but Pena’s combination of reliability and environment makes him the top pick today.
